asked: # AmberX: one-tap "Mic off" kill switch + release the mic for other apps Brett (Nov 1 2026): "AmberX needs a button, a quick switch. It disables all the listening, turns the green dot off my phone, turns off the microphone, completely disables all listening." Also a live bug since this morning: AmberX holds the mic so Claude voice calls can't use it (he had to close AmberX). Likely from recorder-mic (3ba092d2) or amberx-listeners (02e951c2) going live via the 5-min web auto-update. Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md, _claude/THREADS.md and apps/amberx-droid first. ## Build 1. **Mic off switch** (one tap): when ON, AmberX stops EVERY mic user — hands-free listener, wake word, voice notes, agent voice, recorder mic track, overlay mic, anything else found by grepping getUserMedia / AudioRecord / SpeechRecognizer / MediaRecorder / foreground service with microphone type. Release every AudioRecord/stream track, stop the microphone foreground service, so Android's green privacy dot goes OFF. Nothing may re-open the mic until he turns it back on (guard at the single place mic access is granted). Persists across restarts. 2. Where: a big toggle on AmberX Home + in the banner/toolbar, a quick-settings tile and a notification action if the Android shell supports it, voice command "mic off" is NOT enough (needs the mic) — the button is the point. Clear state: "Mic off" / "Listening". 3. **Fix the hog**: when not explicitly listening, AmberX must not hold the mic. Request audio focus / handle loss so when another app (Claude voice call, phone call) needs the mic, AmberX lets go immediately and pauses listening; resume only when that app is done. Find and report which change caused the grab. 4. Framework controls + hot-swappable assets, scale tokens; help@1 entry for the switch. Tests, lifecycle + theme checks, phone screenshots, report `_claude/builds/reports/amberx-mic-kill.md`, THREADS row, STATUS. Note in the report whether a NEW APK is required (native service changes) or the web auto-update is enough, and kick the Android CI build if an APK is needed. Commit on this branch, merge origin/main, push the branch. Do NOT push to main; Brett's session lands it with build_land. Never print secrets. Short phone-readable summary at the end. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.

Native MicGuard, tile, notification; page gate; Home/banner/toolbar/menu/settings; yield to calls + other apps; tests, report

result.summary: AmberX Mic off kill switch (native MicGuard + page gate, Home/banner/toolbar/menu/settings, QS tile, notification action) and hands-free now yields the mic to calls/VoIP/other apps. New APK required; Android CI dispatched.
